title: JBrowse 2 config.json projector
context: M1 requires packs to emit all three browser targets (UCSC, JBrowse 2, IGV) from one canonical manifest so configs never drift. The manifest-first architecture means JBrowse 2 config.json is a projection of the manifest — a separate browser-specific adapter — not a hand-maintained parallel file. This task implements that projector, following the same adapter-isolation pattern as the M0 UCSC hub generator.
objective: Implement a JBrowse 2 config.json projector that emits a valid, spec-compliant JBrowse 2 config from the canonical manifest, with golden-fixture CI tests and attribution + not-medical-advice carried through.
acceptanceCriteria: Emits a valid JBrowse 2 config.json as a projection of the canonical manifest; output is validated against the JBrowse 2 config.json schema.
Attribution string and not-medical-advice/intended-use statement are present in the emitted config.
Golden manifest → expected config.json fixtures are committed and diffed in CI using only synthetic fixtures.
Code is MIT-licensed; no credentials embedded; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; commit is DCO signed-off.
output: packages/adapters/jbrowse/src/ — JBrowse 2 config.json projector; packages/adapters/jbrowse/test/ golden fixtures; submitted as a PR.
